description: This file defines the SuggestionAdapter class, a custom CursorAdapter for displaying search suggestions in an Android app. It inflates suggestion item views and binds data from a Cursor, including handling icons and fallback images.

classes.name: SuggestionAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter for displaying search suggestions, inflating views and binding suggestion text and icons, with fallback handling for missing icons.

methods.name: newView
methods.description: Creates a new view for a suggestion item by inflating the layout.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds data from the cursor to the suggestion view, setting the suggestion text and icon, with exception handling for missing or invalid icon data.
